issuing_body: 経済産業省 (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, METI)

evidence.quote: AI・データの利用に関する契約ガイドライン 1.1 版

implementation_notes: This is a non-binding guideline (version 1.1, revised December 2019 from June 2018 original) providing model contract clauses and considerations for data contracts covering three types: data provision contracts, data creation contracts, and data sharing platform contracts. It explicitly states it does not restrict freedom of contract. Revision addressed alignment with guidelines on limited-provision data (限定提供データ).
